sun:fire-fire: Both Suns are fire: energy, courage and passion are your shared language. Let the competition be fuel, not a spark that sets things off.
sun:fire-earth: Fire wants speed, earth wants stability; one starts things, the other finishes them. Patience and eagerness teach each other.
sun:fire-air: Fire and air feed each other: ideas fan the flame, and the flame puts ideas into motion. There's a natural momentum between you.
sun:fire-water: Fire and water make steam: passion and feeling run intense, but balance is hard. You'll need to find a measure where one doesn't scorch and the other doesn't douse.
sun:earth-earth: Two earths: trust, continuity and love you can touch. Surprise is something you'll need to add on purpose.
sun:earth-air: Earth wants to build, air wants to understand; the practical and the conceptual complete each other. Some translating between concrete and abstract is needed.
sun:earth-water: Earth and water nourish each other: feeling takes root, and trust softens into tenderness. This is one of the most natural matches there is.
sun:air-air: Two airs: conversation, ideas and freedom are your shared language. Don't forget to talk about feelings, too.
sun:air-water: Air explains, water feels; one spells things out while the other senses them. You may be saying the same thing in different languages.
sun:water-water: Two waters: a deep, intuitive and tender bond. You'll need a shoreline so neither of you gets swept up in the other's tide.
moon:fire-fire: Both Moons are fire: feelings run quick, open and lively. A warm home, a noisy peace.
moon:fire-earth: One wants feelings right away, the other warms up gradually; the difference in pace is the biggest lesson. Patience does fire good, and courage does earth good.
moon:fire-air: Feelings get processed through talk and movement; daily life is light, cheerful and easy-flowing. Depth is something you'll need to invite on purpose.
moon:fire-water: One lets feelings out, the other takes them in; there's a risk of misreading each other. You meet once you both say what you need.
moon:earth-earth: Two earth Moons: routine, touch and trust are shared needs. Being together is easy; changing is hard.
moon:earth-air: One wants tangible security, the other wants mental space; your needs speak different languages. Understanding is built by talking and by doing.
moon:earth-water: Earth and water Moons nourish each other easily: care, tenderness and continuity. A bond that feels like home.
moon:air-air: Two air Moons: freedom and conversation mean emotional safety. Space is good for you both, just don't both run at the same time.
moon:air-water: One wants to understand feelings, the other wants to feel them; with patience you complete each other. Listening becomes the bridge between you.
moon:water-water: Two water Moons: wordless understanding, deep empathy. You'll need to tell whose feeling belongs to whom.
